overview: Medford High School students presented Mustang Report 7, featuring a classroom relay game, coverage of a track meet against Arlington Catholic, and holiday tradition interviews with students and staff.

items.title: Mustang Report Intro and Classroom Relay Game
items.summary: Students opened the broadcast with holiday singing before competing in a classroom relay game.

items.title: Medford vs. Arlington Catholic Track Meet
items.summary: Student reporters provided coverage of the Medford track meet against Arlington Catholic and interviewed student-athletes.

items.title: Holiday Tradition Interviews and Ugly Sweater Contest
items.summary: Students and faculty shared their holiday plans, favorite meals, and movies, and Raquel Quiroz was named winner of the sweater contest.
